name: dsh-chat
description: Chat | Code tabs for the DSH web GUI. Chat mode is 1:1 with Code: chats are REAL DSH sessions living in one hidden temp-folder workspace (~/.dsh/dsh-chat-work, titled Chat) with the full agent toolset. The client only adds the tab bar, a New chat button, and workspace-group filtering; the official session list + conversation view do the rest.
